role: Generate ONE section of a Greek slide deck as JS calls to paste into an existing script (Zone01 template). Output ONLY the calls, no prose. Self-contained — you do not need any other file.
response_format: Provide the output as an actual attached/downloadable file. Do not paste it as plain chat text. If the platform genuinely cannot attach files, wrap the ENTIRE output in five backticks on their own line before and after (````` ... `````) as one block.
exact_syntax: addContent(`...raw HTML...`, opts?); addQuiz([{q,options:[4],correct:idx,explain}, ...], opts?); addFillBlank([{code,blanks:[{id,answer}],explain}], opts?); addMatching([{term,def}, ...] | [set1, set2, ...], opts?) — backticks exactly as shown for addContent, real JS array/object literals for the rest.

js_api.addContent(html, opts?): one slide; use only h1 h2 h3 p p.lede div.callout(.good) div.grid2/grid3>div.card pre>code table.glossary-table div.glossary-strip div.glossary-columns div.sources-list>a — never plain unwrapped text
js_api.addFillBlank([{code,blanks:[{id,answer}]: mark blanks as __id__ in code; Check/Reveal-hint/wrong-answer UI is automatic, don't build it yourself
js_api.addMatching([{term,def}] | [[...],[...]]: matching pairs; pass an array of arrays for 2-3 independent sets on one slide

opts.label: override header text
opts.bg: background image path, works on all 4 functions, default none
opts.backgroundPosition: CSS position value, default "top left", e.g. "center center"

spoiler_minigame:
Optional drag-to-reveal block, embeddable inside addContent():
Drag to reveal →
...
— unlocks only by dragging, not clicking.
code_blocks: Colored code: hand-wrap words in <span class="tok-kw|tok-type|tok-str|tok-com|tok-num|tok-func"> yourself, no auto-highlighter to rely on. Escape < > & as < > & inside code text (it sits inside HTML).
scoring_note: Quiz/fillblank/matching are scored automatically by the engine — don't add score text yourself, it's handled elsewhere.
rules: quiz options same length/style, correct slot varies, distractors plausible not silly, one ~5-words-longer distractor somewhere
code blocks self-contained and fully commented
do not solve the actual exercise — theory/tools only
do not include title/sources/init slides — only this section's content
